title: Restore the exact recorded-cwd assertion in the launcher stage-cwd test
outcome:
A Low from review delegation-5c032e6c on w-ae4b52018e7f. The CI alias fix also wrapped the recorded-cwd check in the stage-cwd test (scripts/test-launcher.test.mjs, `realpathSync.native(result.stages[0].cwd)` against `realpathSync.native(ui)`) in canonicalisation. The launcher records a lexical stageDirectory(request.root, "ui") from a resolve()d root, so the old exact comparison was not alias-sensitive. The canonical comparison weakens the pin that the launcher records the request-derived spelling.
Restore `assert.equal(result.stages[0].cwd, ui)`, keeping the realpath comparisons for the child's process.cwd() and for the Git-derived run directory.
acceptance: The stage-cwd test compares the recorded stage cwd with the request-derived ui path exactly, keeps the canonical comparison for the child's cwd, and the launcher tests pass on Windows (including under an 8.3 short-name temp) and in CI on macOS.
